# THEA at the Table: full text

Source: https://theasty.com. Author: Thea VanHerwaarden.

## Braised Short Rib and Mussels
URL: https://theasty.com/braised-beef-with-mussels-using-canada-beef/
Published: 2021-09-23

West Coast flavours mean seafood. But B.C. beef holds its own. I teamed up with Canada Beef to give surf and turf a West Coast spin: braised short rib and mussels.


### Ingredients
- For the Short Rib: 4 whole short rib on the bone
- For the Short Rib: 1 large carrot – diced
- For the Short Rib: 1 large yellow onion – diced
- For the Short Rib: 6 cloves of garlic – crushed
- For the Short Rib: 3 sprigs thyme
- For the Short Rib: 1 750 ml bottle of red wine or 375ml of red wine with 375 ml of beef stock
- For the Short Rib: ½ stick of unsalted butter
- For the Short Rib: Canola oil
- For the Short Rib: Kosher salt
- For the Mussels: 2 tablespoons neutral oil
- For the Mussels: 1 shallot – thinly sliced
- For the Mussels: 4 cloves of garlic – minced
- For the Mussels: Approx. 2 cups of dry white wine
- For the Mussels: Approx. 20-25 fresh mussels – cleaned with beards removed.
- For the Mussels: 1 bunch of Italian parsley – roughly chopped
- For the Mussels: 3/4 stick of unsalted butter
- For the Mussels: Kosher salt

### Method
1. For the Short Rib: Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. For the Short Rib: Dab each short rib with paper towel and season generously with kosher salt. Set aside for 15 – 20 minutes.
3. For the Short Rib: In a medium to large Dutch oven over medium high heat, add oil until it coats the bottom.
4. For the Short Rib: Dab short rib again to remove excess moisture. Brown each side of short rib cooking in batches if needed. Once browned remove and set aside.
5. For the Short Rib: Add diced onion, carrot, and crushed garlic with a pinch of salt. Sauté for 1 minute. Pour half a bottle of red wine into Dutch oven to deglaze the pan. Allow wine to come to temperature.
6. For the Short Rib: Add short rib back into Dutch oven bone side down – if possible. Add remaining wine or beef stock until liquid just about covers the short rib. Place lid on top and cook in oven for 3.5 hours or until very tender.
7. For the Short Rib: Once cooked, carefully remove each short rib and place on a plate. Cover in tinfoil and allow to rest.
8. For the Short Rib: Strain braising liquid and place back into Dutch oven. Cook liquid over medium/medium high heat until fully reduced. Liquid should be very thick. Reduce heat to low. While stirring consistently, slowly add the ½ stick of butter. Sauce should be glossy like a glaze. Set aside.
9. For the Mussels: In a sauté pan on medium heat add 2 tablespoons of oil. Add shallot and garlic. Sauté until soft. Deglaze pan with dry white wine. Allow wine to come up to temperature. Add mussels and put lid on to allow the steam to open the mussels. Keep the mussels moving while steaming. Once most shells are open, remove mussels into a bowl. Keep in mind mussels do not take long to cook so keep your eye on it. Remove half the mussels from the shell and keep the remaining in the shell. Set aside.
10. For the Mussels: Reduce heat to low. While consistently stirring, add butter and fresh parsley. Continue to stir until sauce thickens and butter is fully melted. Add mussels back into white wine garlic-butter sauce and stir until mussels are lightly coated.
11. To Serve: Spoon white wine garlic-butter sauce on bottom of serving dish. Slightly reheat glaze. Drizzle glaze over top of each short rib on the plate they were resting on. Place one short rib in middle of the serving dish. Add mussels in and out of shell around short rib. Top with your favorite garnish (parsley/chervil).

## Beaver Tails
URL: https://theasty.com/beaver-tail-recipe/
Published: 2021-06-27

A Canadian staple, at least in my house. No grand introduction needed. Craving something sweet this morning? Try Beaver Tails.


### Ingredients
- 4 teaspoons yeast ½ cup warm water ½ cup milk warmed 5 tablespoons unsalted butter melted ½ cup sugar plus 1 tablespoon 2- 4 cups all-purpose flour Pinch of salt Vegetable oil for frying Cinnamon and sugar (to coat)

### Method
1. Place yeast in warm water with a tablespoon of sugar. Let sit for 10 minutes until the yeast is nice and frothy.
2. In a large bowl, add 2 cups of flour, sugar and a pinch of salt. Make a well and add eggs, warm milk, yeast mixture, and melted butter. Begin to form a dough. If the dough is wet, continue to add flour until it no longer sticks to the bowl. Knead dough on hard surface until smooth and elastic.
3. Grease and place dough back into the bowl. Cover with a dishtowel or saran wrap and allow to rest for 1 – ½ hours or until double in size.
4. Punch dough down and divide into 12 equal balls. 24 balls if you wish to have mini beavertails.
5. Heat about 2 inches of oil in a large high-sided pot to 350 degrees.
6. Roll each ball into an oval. Place in oil and cook on each side for about 30-45 seconds or until golden brown.
7. Remove and place briefly on a paper towel to remove excess oil. Toss in cinnamon sugar and repeat with remaining balls. Enjoy.

## Eggs Benny Breakfast Pizza
URL: https://theasty.com/eggs-benedict-breakfast-pizza-eggs-benny/
Published: 2021-04-18

I like pizza for dinner, leftover pizza for lunch, even dessert pizza, and yes, for breakfast. Not a cold slice from the fridge, though. This is Eggs Benedict on a thin-crust pizza, with hollandaise and green onion.

Isn't pizza crust just another form of toast? It's also a good one to make with the kids.


### Ingredients
- For the Pizza Dough: 1 ½ cups of water
- For the Pizza Dough: ½ tablespoon sugar
- For the Pizza Dough: 1 package instant yeast
- For the Pizza Dough: 2 tablespoon olive oil
- For the Pizza Dough: 2 teaspoons salt
- For the Pizza Dough: 3-4 cups of flour (Bread or All Purpose)
- For the Bechamel: 2 tablespoons butter
- For the Bechamel: 2 tablespoons flour
- For the Bechamel: 1 ¼ cup milk (warmed)
- For the Bechamel: Salt to taste
- For the Hollandaise Sauce: 1 egg yolk
- For the Hollandaise Sauce: 1 -2 teaspoons of lemon juice
- For the Hollandaise Sauce: 1-2 teaspoons of water
- For the Hollandaise Sauce: 1 stick of butter
- For the Hollandaise Sauce: Salt and pepper to taste
- Toppings: 6 slices of prosciutto
- Toppings: 3 eggs
- Toppings: 1 tablespoon of chopped green onion
- Toppings: 1 cup of mozzarella cheese (I used a fresh mozzarella ball sliced)
- Toppings: ½ cup cheddar cheese

### Method
1. For the Pizza Dough: In a bowl, place yeast and sugar in the warm water. Allow to sit until yeast is frothy (about 10 minutes). Add olive oil, flour and salt. Mix until a dough starts to form. Knead dough for about 10 minutes (I use a stand mixture with a paddle attached). If dough is still sticky, add a little extra flour. Once smooth, form a ball and place in a grease bowl covered with saran wrap and a dish towel. Leave for an hour or until double in size. You can also make the night before and have it rest overnight.
2. For the Bechamel: Melt butter in a saucepan on medium heat. Stir in flour and continue stirring until mixture resembles a paste. Continue to cook for 2 minutes being careful not to brown the sauce.
3. For the Bechamel: A little at a time, pour in milk while continuing to stir. Once all milk is incorporated, cook for an additional 3 to 4 minutes. The sauce should be a nice thick consistency. Season with salt and pepper and set aside until ready to use.
4. For the Hollandaise: In a cup that just fits the head of an immersion blender, add egg yolk, water and lemon juice. Melt butter in a pan over medium high heat. Once completely melted, add to a liquid measuring cup.
5. For the Hollandaise: Place head of immersion blender into the bottom of the cup and turn on. While running, slowly add the melted butter until all butter is gone. The butter should emulsify with the egg yolk, lemon and butter and form a sauce. If too thick, add a teaspoon more of water. Season to taste and set aside.
6. To Cook the Pizza: Preheat oven to highest setting (mine was 500 degrees F).
7. To Cook the Pizza: Remove ¼ of dough from bowl. Dust surface and dough with flour and roll out to the size of your pizza pan. Dough should be fairly thin but you can opt for a thicker crust if you like.
8. To Cook the Pizza: Place dough on a greased pizza pan. Cook for about 3-5 minutes; just until dough starts to cook (this will prevent the sauce from making the crust soggy and stick to the pan).
9. To Cook the Pizza: Remove from oven.
10. To Cook the Pizza: Smear a thin layer of bechamel sauce onto pizza dough. Repeat with a thin layer of hollandaise. Next, place a thin layer of mozzarella and cheddar cheese. Finally, carefully crack three eggs onto the pizza. Place pizza in oven and cook until crust is golden brown, and eggs are set.
11. To Cook the Pizza: Remove from heat and top with prosciutto, green onion and season with salt and pepper. Slice up and serve while warm.

## Crispy Skin Salmon with Mango Salsa
URL: https://theasty.com/crispy-skin-salmon-with-mango-salsa/
Published: 2021-03-08

I have eaten barbecue in Texas and curry in Indonesia, but nothing tastes like home to me like well-cooked salmon. This crispy skin salmon with mango, corn and black bean salsa is a crowd pleaser, scales up or down, and takes less than 20 minutes.


### Ingredients
- For the Salmon: Four 2-4 oz fillets of salmon deboned with skin
- For the Salmon: Kosher Salt
- For the Salmon: 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- For the Salmon: 1 tablespoon unsalted butter
- For the Salmon: ¼ fresh lemon
- For the Salsa: 2 mangos peeled, pitted and diced
- For the Salsa: 2 tablespoons of red onion – finely diced
- For the Salsa: ¼ cup green onion chopped
- For the Salsa: 1 Corn on the cob – shucked, cooked and kernels cut off the cob (alternatively you can use canned corn)
- For the Salsa: ½ can of black beans – rinsed and strained
- For the Salsa: 2 cloves garlic minced
- For the Salsa: 1-1/2 tablespoons lime juice
- For the Salsa: Salt and pepper to taste

### Method
1. For the mango salsa: Add diced mangos, red onion, green onion, corn, black beans, minced garlic, lime juice into a medium bowl. Mix until well incorporated. Add Salt and pepper to desired taste. Set in the fridge until ready to serve.
2. For the salmon: Season fillets generously with salt and place on a paper towel. Allow to sit for 10-15 minutes.
3. For the salmon: Remove excess moisture from fillets using a paper towel until dry . Heat a medium nonstick skillet on medium high heat. Once hot, add vegetable oil.
4. For the salmon: Place Salmon skin side down using your hand or spatula to press firmly down on skin for 15 seconds. Reduce heat to medium and cook skin side down for 4-6 minutes. If the pan is still too hot and skin is turning too dark, reduce heat further.
5. For the salmon: Flip salmon and add butter. Baste salmon while cooking for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute. Add a squeeze of lemon and remove the pan from heat.
6. For the salmon: Serve with your choice of side (coconut rice, sweet potato puree) and top with a generous amount of mango salsa.

## Théasty Beef Ramen
URL: https://theasty.com/theasty-beef-ramen/
Published: 2021-02-26

I never tried ramen until a local restaurant put one on the menu on a cold day. I ate it every day for two weeks, and they never put it back. So I made my own: rich spicy broth, tender steak, noodles and a perfect boiled egg, in far less time than a traditional broth.

Lime, cilantro and chili brighten it up and give it a slight Thai flavour.


### Ingredients
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 5 cloves garlic (sliced )
- 2 stalks lemongrass (thinly sliced)
- 1 medium sweet onion (diced )
- 1 peice ginger (approx 2 inches peeled and cut into large chunks (about 1/4 inch))
- 4 medium Carrots (peeled and cut into chunks about 1/2 inch thick)
- 2 serrano peppers (or other chili pepper for heat (my own preference))
- 1 bunch green onions (thinly sliced )
- 8 cups beef broth (you can also opt for chicken broth)
- 1/4 cup soy sauce
- 2 tablespoons Mirin
- 3 tablespoons miso paste
- 15 dried shiitake mushrooms
- 4 whole eggs
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 2-4 packages ramen noodles
- 1 can corn
- 1 bunch bok choy
- 1/2 bag bean sprouts
- 12 oz cooked and thinly sliced boneless steak (I used a thin tenderloin but you can use Flank steak or NY Strip)
- 1 bunch Green Onion (chopped thin)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)
- 1 Serrano pepper
- 1 lime (cut into wedges)
- 1/4 cup Cilantro (for garnish)

### Method
1. For the Broth: In a large pot over medium high heat, add oil, lemongrass, carrots, green onions, garlic, serrano pepper, ginger and sweet onion. Cook for approximately 5 minutes. Add broth, shiitake mushrooms, mirin, soy sauce and miso then reduce heat and let simmer until flavors deepen (20 -30+ minutes).
2. For the Broth: When ready, strain the bits out and reserve broth until ready to serve.
3. For the Eggs: In a medium pot, boil a pot of water. Once water is boiling, place eggs in pot and cook for 7 minutes. While the eggs are cooking, get a bowl with ice water. Pull eggs out and place in ice water bath to stop the cooking. Once eggs are cool enough (about 2 minutes) carefully peel and set aside.
4. For the Noodles: Meanwhile, Cook noodles in a medium pot of salted water (according to package). Drain and rinse.
5. To Serve: When you are ready to eat, heat up broth to a simmer and add bok choy. After about 2-3 minutes, serve broth into desire bowls with the bok choy. Add corn, bean sprouts and desired amount of steak. With the eggs you cooked, cut one in half and place on top. To finish, garnish with green onion, sliced serrano/chilis, wedge of lime and cilantro.

## Thea’s Théasty Smashburgers
URL: https://theasty.com/theasty-smashburgers/
Published: 2021-02-09

Ultra crispy edges, no filler. Finally on the blog after many requests.


### Ingredients
- For the Burger Patty: 1 lb Ground Chuck 80/20
- For the Burger Patty: Salt and pepper
- For the Burger Patty: 1 tablespoon vegetable oil
- Burger fixings: Brioche or Potatoes buns (1 for each patty)
- Burger fixings: 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- Burger fixings: Cheese Slices (1 for each full-sized patty or ½ for mini patty)
- Burger fixings: Iceberg lettuce
- Burger fixings: Tomato slices
- Burger fixings: Dill Pickles
- Burger fixings: Thinly sliced white or red onion
- Special Sauce: ¼ cup mayonnaise
- Special Sauce: 2 tablespoons ketchup
- Special Sauce: 1 ½ tablespoon mustard
- Special Sauce: ¾ tablespoon relish
- Special Sauce: Pinch of salt and pepper

### Method
1. Heat cast iron skillet on medium heat. Butter buns and toast on skillet. Set aside.
2. Divide ground chuck into four 4 oz patties or eight 2 oz patties. Careful not to overwork the meat.
3. Turn skillet to medium high. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil on skillet. Season tops of divided ground chuck with salt just before placing on skillet.
4. With a heavy set flat spatula, flatten patty until about ½ inch thick. Ensure you flatten within the first 30 seconds. After, do not flatten or squish the patty. Cook for approximately 2 minutes or until you notice liquid surfacing on the top of the patty (fat rendering). Flip and add cheese. Cook until cheese is melted and remove from heat. Continue until all patties are completed.
5. For special sauce: Mix mayonnaise, ketchup, mustard, relish salt and pepper until well combined.
6. To Assemble: Spread special sauce onto toasted brioche. Add onion, beef patty, lettuce, tomato and dill pickle. Enjoy!

## Lazy Artisan Bread
URL: https://theasty.com/lazy-artisan-bread/
Published: 2020-03-27

Artisan bread always looked complicated, so I went looking for the simplest recipe: four ingredients, no knead. Crunchy and chewy outside, soft inside. My favourite use is grilled cheese dipped in homemade tomato soup. One hiccup: make it a day ahead. Bake Friday and you have warm bread all weekend.


### Ingredients
- 3 cups flour (all purpose or bread flour)
- 2 1/2 teaspoons instant yeast
- 1 1/2 cups water (lukewarm)
- 1 teaspoon salt

### Method
1. In a large bowl, add water, yeast, salt and flour. Mix until there is not a dry bit of flour. The dough should be moist and wet. . Cover in saran wrap and let sit for 8-12 hours or overnight.
2. Once rested, remove saran wrap and, beginning with the top of the dough, pull it and stretch it to the bottom. Then moving clockwise continue (pull right side up and stretch across to the left, pull bottom up across to the top and left up across to the right). Flip the dough over and let sit (covered) for 30 minutes. Repeat 2- 3 more times.
3. When ready to bake, preheat oven to 450 degrees F.
4. Dust flour onto a piece of parchment paper just larger than the dough. Roll dough onto parchment paper. Dust lightly with flour. Place parchment paper into dutch oven. Let sit for 30 minutes. Score bread (as desired).
5. Cook with lid on for about 30 minutes and then remove lid and cook for another 30 minutes or until crust is dark brown.
6. Pull out of the oven and allow to cool for 10-15 minutes then it’s ready to serve.

## Maple Whiskey Fried Chicken with Cornmeal Pancakes and Herb-Chili Maple Syrup
URL: https://theasty.com/maple-whiskey-buttermilk-fried-chicken-buttermilk-cornmeal-pancakes-with-herb-and-chili-maple-syrup/
Published: 2020-03-02

My waffle maker broke, so: pancakes. A bottle of unopened Canadian maple whiskey went into the chicken marinade. Chicken and waffles, headed north, and now my favourite version.


### Ingredients
- 1 cup all purpose flour
- 1 cup yellow cornmeal
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1 1/2 cups buttermilk
- 2 1/2 tablespoons Sugar
- 2 eggs
- pinch salt
- 3 tablespoon vegetable oil
- 8 boneless skinless chicken thighs
- 3-4 cups buttermilk
- 1/4 - 1/2 cup maple whiskey ((optional))
- 4 cups flour
- 1 tablespoon garlic powder
- 1 teaspoon cayenne pepper
- 2 teaspoons smoked paprika
- 2 tablespoons kosher salt
- 2 teaspoons pepper
- vegetable oil (for frying chicken)
- 1 cup maple syrup
- 2 springs thyme
- 1 spring rosemary
- 1/4 teaspoon Chili powder

### Method
1. In a medium sized casserole dish or similar, add buttermilk, eggs and maple whiskey. Mix until combined. Add chicken thighs (should be coated). Let sit for at least 30 minutes ( if you want you can let sit overnight. Just wrap in saran wrap and place in fridge).
2. For the pancakes: Place your dry ingredients (flour, baking powder, cornmeal, sugar, salt) in a large bowl and mix until combined. You can sift flour if you want to ensure no lumps in batter at the end.
3. For the pancakes: Add buttermilk, eggs, vegetable oil. Mix until it makes a nice batter.
4. For the pancakes: To keep pancakes warm while cooking, preheat oven to 300 degrees (or your lowest setting on your oven) and place a baking sheet in the oven.
5. For the pancakes: Lightly coat a large skillet with nonstick spray and place on stovetop on medium to medium high heat. Working in batches, pour about 1/4 cup of batter into skillet. Cook on one side until golden, then flip and cook for an additional minute.
6. For the pancakes: Place cooked pancake in oven and repeat until batter is gone.
7. For the chicken: While chicken is in the buttermilk mixture, mix flour, cayenne, smoked paprika, salt, pepper and garlic powder together until well combined. Remove each thigh one at a time from the buttermilk mixture and transfer to the flour mixture. Make sure each thigh is coated well, shake off excess and place back into buttermilk mixture. Coat in buttermilk and then return back to flour. Shake off excess flour and place on a plate until ready to cook.
8. For the chicken: In a medium size Dutch oven or equivalent, heat up vegetable oil until it reaches 350 degrees F. Gently place two or three chicken thighs at a time in the Dutch oven. Be careful to not overcrowd or add too many at once as this can result in uneven cooking. Flip chicken midway to ensure each side gets a perfect golden brown. Using a digital thermometer, cook chicken until it reaches 165 degrees. Time can vary so a digital thermometer is your friend. Remove chicken and place on a wired rack over top of a baking sheet to allow the leftover oils to drip down. Continue until all chicken is cooked.
9. For the chicken: *You can keep cooked chicken in the low heated oven to keep warm with the pancakes.
10. For the Syrup: In a small saucepan, add maple syrup, chili powder, cayenne, thyme, and rosemary. Heat gently until flavors infuse into syrup (about 7 minutes). Make sure not to bring syrup to boil. Strain and set aside until ready to serve.
11. To Serve: Pile pancakes and top with 1 – 2 pieces of chicken. Drizzle with syrup and enjoy!
12. To Serve: * Great for leftovers.. if there are any*

---

## Braised Chili in Adobo Beef Tacos with Roasted Pineapple Salsa
URL: https://theasty.com/braised-chili-in-adobo-beef-tacos-with-roasted-pineapple-salsa/
Published: 2020-01-27

Cold, dreadful weather, braised meat on my mind, and an inside round roast on sale. It's flavourful and just needs a little extra time, which is what a pressure cooker is for.

I love pineapple with braised beef, so it goes in two ways: a spicy salsa of grilled pineapple and roasted peppers, plus grilled chunks. No pressure cooker? Use a dutch oven, about 3 hours at 350 F.


### Ingredients
- 1 tablespoon Chili powder
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 1 tablespoon smoked paprika
- 1/2 tablespoon Cumin
- Salt and Pepper (own discretion (see directions))
- 2-3 pounds inside round beef roast (cut into 4-5 chunks)
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil (divided)
- 1 small sweet onion (chopped loosely into chunks)
- 2 stalks celery (chipped loosley into chunks)
- 6 cloves garlic (smashed)
- 1 cup red wine
- 2 cans Chili in Adobo sauce
- 1 tablespoon cocoa powder
- 3 tablespoons instant coffee
- 3 + cups beef stock
- 2 tablespoons lime juice
- 2 bay leafs
- 1 Pineapple (Peeled, Cored, and cut into 1/2 inch rings)
- 1 Poblano pepper
- 1 Jalapeno Pepper
- 1/4 Red Onion
- 1 loose cup Cilantro
- 2 tablespoons lime juice
- 1 tablespoon olive oil (divided)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)
- radish (sliced thinly)
- corn on the cob (shucked, cooked and cut off the cob)
- Avocado (peeled, cored and sliced thinly)
- sour cream
- Corn or Flour Torillas (Warmed)
- goat cheese

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees F.
2. Mix chili powder, cumin, smoked paprika, brown sugar, salt and pepper in a small bowl.
3. Rub mixture over beef.
4. In a pressure cooker, on medium high heat add a tablespoons of vegetable oil. Brown beef on all sides. Add an additional tablespoon of vegetable oil then and add onions, crushed garlic, and celery. Cook for 2-3 minutes. Deglaze with red wine.
5. Add 2 cans of chili in adobo, cocoa powder, and instant coffee then pour enough beef stock to cover the top of the beef. Note: Be careful not to go over the max limit of liquid in the pressure cooker.
6. Add lime juice and bay leaf then reduce heat to medium. Place lid on pressure cooker, lock and put on setting two. Once steam begins to whistle, reduce heat slightly and maintain consistent steam/whistle for approx 30-40 minutes.
7. Meanwhile, pat down 7- 8 pineapple rings with paper towel. Heat cast iron grill or alternative on medium high heat. Spray nonstick on cast iron or lightly brush with oil. Place pineapple on grill and do not move. Allow to grill for 5-7 minutes or until black grill marks appear. Flip and cook other side for an additional minute. Remove and continue with all the rings. Set aside on paper.
8. Place poblano pepper, jalapeno pepper and red onion in a roasting pan. Roast until the mixture begins to char and peppers are fully cooked.
9. Remove from oven and transfer into a blender. Place half the grilled pineapple into blender with lime juice, cilantro, and olive oil. Puree until smooth. If salsa is too thick, add a tablespoon of water at a time until you reach consistency. Add salt and pepper to taste.
10. Transfer into a container and place in fridge until ready to serve.
11. With the remaining grilled pineapple, dice into thick chunks and place in bowl. Set in fridge until ready to serve.
12. Once beef has done cooking (30-40 mins). Turn off heat and release the steam. Once steam is completely release, remove the lid and remove beef into a bowl. Pull beef apart and set aside.
13. Strain liquid from the beef and place into a pan. Reduce sauce on medium heat until thick and can easily coat the back of the spoon. Pour sauce over the shredded beef and mix until incorporated.
14. Serve shredded beef on tortilla and top with roasted pineapple salsa, avocado, grilled pineapple, roasted corn, radish, sour cream, goat cheese and cilantro.

### Notes
and Additions
you can opt to slow braise the beef by placing in a dutch oven and braising for 3 -4 hours.
If you want goat cheese “crema” you can make a simple one by mixing 1/4 cup of sour cream and 2-3 tablespoons of goat cheese. For added flavor include 1 teaspoon of lime juice and 1/2 teaspoon of minced garlic, salt and pepper
If you want a quick pickled radish, heat up equal parts sugar and vinegar of choice. Pour over sliced radish and allow to sit for 30 minutes.

## Classic Cranberry Sauce with Balsamic Vinegar
URL: https://theasty.com/classic-cranberry-sauce-with-balsamic-vinegar/
Published: 2019-12-31

Giulia Lombardo of Just Giulia and I created holiday spreads for before and after the season, and nothing says holidays like homemade cranberry sauce. A classic, and simple.


### Ingredients
- 600 grams fresh cranberries
- 1 cup sugar
- 1 whole orange (cut in half)
- 1 liter cranberry juice
- 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 1/2 teaspoon black pepper
- 1/4 cup balsamic vinegar

### Method
1. Over medium low heat in a large sauce pan combine all ingredient and let simmer for 30-40 minutes until the sauce is thick and has a jam like consistency.
2. Remove the orange halves, let cool and serve with your favorite turkey or turkey sandwich,

## Pumpkin Spice Biscotti
URL: https://theasty.com/pumpkin-spice-biscotti/
Published: 2019-11-14

Pumpkin spice rules autumn, and I understand why. If you want a change from the latte, try a biscotti made for dunking: pumpkin spice, dried cranberries and toasted hazelnuts.


### Ingredients
- 4 tablespoons butter (unsalted at room temp)
- 1/2 cup Sugar (plus some for topping)
- pinch salt
- 2 teaspoons pumpkin spice (or sub for cinnamon/clove/nutmeg)
- 1/2 cup pumpkin puree
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 Egg
- 1 1/2 teaspoon baking powder
- 2 cups flour
- 1/4 cup pumpkin seeds (shelled)
- 1/4 cup roasted hazelnuts with skin off (crushed slightly )
- 1/2 cup died cranberries
- 2 cups white chocolate melts

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
2. In a stand mixer or large bowl, mix sugar, butter, spices, salt and baking powder until creamy.
3. Beat in egg, vanilla, and pumpkin puree. Add flour, pumpkin seeds, dried cranberries and crushed hazelnuts and mix until it forms a dough.
4. Transfer dough onto baking sheet and make a log. Flatten log into a long rectangle about an inch thick.
5. Bake in oven until firm (30-40 minutes). Remove from heat and allow to cool. Cut into 1/2 inch thick slices and return side down on baking sheet. Bake for an additional 10 minutes; flip and bake another 10 minutes. Biscottis should be firm. If still soft, bake and additional 5-10 minutes per side.
6. Remove from heat and allow to cool completely.
7. Microwave white chocolate melts in a microwave safe bowl in 15 second increments – stirring each time – until completely melted and smooth. Keeping the baking sheet with parchment paper, dip each biscotti half way in white chocolate and place on baking sheet. Once all are dipped, place in fridge to set.
8. Enjoy with your cup of coffee, tea or just by themselves.

## Stuffing Waffle Turkey Sandwich
URL: https://theasty.com/stuffing-waffles/
Published: 2019-10-03

Every year I get asked about this stuffing waffle, so here it is again for the leftover eaters. Have it with a fried egg for brunch or, my way, as the bread for a turkey sandwich. Easy, and worth it.


### Ingredients
- 4 cups leftover stuffing
- 2 large eggs (lightly beaten)
- 1/4-1/2 cup broth (any broth)

### Method
1. Turn waffle maker on and coat lightly with a non-stick spray
2. Add stuffing, eggs, and broth in a bowl to make a batter. Once waffle maker is hot, add batter to lightly cover the base of the waffle maker. Cook for 5 – 7 minutes or until waffle is golden brown. Place waffle on a plate and allow to cool.
3. Add turkey, cranberry sauce, and/or any other favorite turkey sandwich items on top of one piece of waffle. Make a sandwich with the other half and enjoy

---

## Braised Short Rib Ragu
URL: https://theasty.com/braised-short-rib-ragu/
Published: 2019-09-27

Slow braised short rib ragu in one pot. Use an Instant Pot, a pressure cooker or, like me, a Dutch oven, and let red wine, beef, crushed tomatoes and herbs fill the house. I make fresh trofie while it braises, but any pasta that holds the ragu works.


### Ingredients
- 4 short rib (4 depending on amount of meat on each could be more)
- Salt and Pepper
- 3 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 6 cloves garlic (crushed)
- 1 large sweet onion (diced)
- 1 large can Crushed Tomatoes (28oz can or close to)
- 1/2 bottle red wine (anywhere from half a bottle to a full bottle depending on size of pot and short rib *see notes)
- 2 bay leafs
- 4 springs thyme
- 400 grams pasta (your choice!)

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees F.
2. Pat short rib dry and season heavily with salt and pepper.
3. In a small to medium sized dutch oven or equivalent, on medium high heat, add 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil and brown each side of short ribs. Remove short ribs from heat and set aside.
4. Reduce heat to medium.
5. Drizzle 1 tablespoon of oil and add onion and smashed garlic. Saute until onion is translucent in color. Add red wine and allow to cook for approximately 5-10 minutes. Place short rib back into the pot. Add just enough of the crushed tomatoes to just cover the tops of the short rib. Add thyme, and bay leafs.
6. Cover with lid and cook for approximately 3- 3 1/2 hours or until meat falls apart.
7. Once cooked, remove bones, herbs and shred meat into sauce.
8. Boil a pot of salted water. Cook pasta until al dente. Transfer cooked noodles into ragu adding 3/4 cup of the pasta water. Mix well.
9. Serve immediately topped with grated Parmesan and burrata.

### Notes
I tend to use anywhere from 3/4 to a full bottle of wine in my short rib. Allowing it to reduce for about 10-15 minutes then just adding enough crushed tomato to cover the tops of the short rib. This all depends on the size of your short rib and the size of your pot.

---

## Greek Kebabs with Tzatziki + Garlic Naan
URL: https://theasty.com/greek-kebabs/
Published: 2019-09-12

Any chance to BBQ before summer ends and I'm in. It's the one time I let go of control so Texan can help with dinner. When a friend asked me to host her birthday and suggested kebabs, I made a selection of proteins and kept the veggies simple.

I tend to make everything from scratch, so the tzatziki and naan are below. Store-bought works too.


### Ingredients
- 2 whole Top Sirloin Steaks (1 inch thick cut into cubes )
- 2 chicken breast (cut into cubes)
- 2 Red Onion (cut into 1 inch chunks)
- 3 red pepper (cut into 1 inch chunks )
- 3/4 cup olive oil
- 5 cloves garlic (minced )
- 1/4 cup lemon juice
- 1 tablespoon Dijon Mustard
- 2 tablespoons soy sauce
- 3 tablespoons greek seasoning
- 2 teaspoon salt
- 2 teaspoon pepper
- 1/2 cup Fresh Parsley (chopped finely)
- 1/2 Cucumber (shredded with as much moisture removed )
- 1 1/2 cup Greek yogurt (plain)
- 1 1/2 tablespoons lemon juice
- 1 1/2 tablespoon olive oil
- 3 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1 1/2 tablespoons fresh dill (minced)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste )
- 1/2 package active yeast
- 2 tablespoons Sugar
- 1/4 cup warm water
- 4 cups all purpose flour
- 2 teaspoons salt
- 1 teaspoon baking powder
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- 3/4 cup milk (warm)
- 3/4 cup Plain Yogurt
- oil (to coat bowl or cooking spray)
- 3 tablespoons unsalted butter (melted)
- 2 cloves garlic (minced )
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil

### Method
1. For the Kebabs: In two separate Tupperware containers, add cubes of beef in one and chicken in the other.
2. For the Kebabs: In a medium bowl, combine olive oil, soy sauce, mustard, lemon juice, minced garlic, salt, pepper, Greek seasoning, parsley and mix well.
3. For the Kebabs: Divide marinade between both Tupperware containers containing the meat. Seal with a lid, shake and place in fridge for an hour.
4. For the Kebabs: Once marinated, layer steak or chicken and veggies onto kebabs. Repeat until each kebab is full and all the meat is gone. Place on separate trays and place in fridge until ready to grill.
5. For the Kebabs: Preheat the grill to medium high heat. Place kebabs on grill. Cook until meat is cooked through ( 8-10 minutes ) rotating every few minutes. Once cooked, remove from heat and place on serving tray.
6. For the Tzatziki: In a small bowl, mix together yogurt, shredded cucumber, dill, garlic, lemon juice. Add salt and pepper to taste. Cover and place in fridge until ready to serve.
7. For the Naan: Place warm water yeast and sugar in a small bowl. allow to sit for 10 minutes until yeast is foamy.
8. For the Naan: Meanwhile in a medium sized bowl, add flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Mix until combined.
9. For the Naan: Make a well in the flour and add milk, yeast mixture, and yogurt. Mix until a dough forms. Knead dough until smooth (about 5-7 minutes). Form a ball and place in a lightly greased bowl and cover with saran wrap or a dish towel. Allow to rest for an hour or until double in size.
10. For the Naan: Once rested, divide into 10-12 balls.
11. For the Naan: Combine minced garlic and melted butter in a small bowl. Set aside.
12. For the Naan: Heat up a cast iron skillet and drizzle 1 – 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil on medium high heat. Roll out a ball of dough to about 6-8 inches long and about 1/4 inch thin. Place in pan and cook for about 1 minute (bubbles will form) then flip and cook an additional 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat and brush a light coat of melted garlic butter and place on a plate with a dish towel over top to keep warm. Repeat with remaining dough. Alternatively, you can brush naan with garlic butter before placing in pan to cook but I prefer after to avoid the garlic from burning.
13. To serve: Pick desired Kebabs – removing meat and vegetables off of skewer, and place on fresh naan. Top with tzatziki and enjoy!

---

## Blackberry Sweet Rolls
URL: https://theasty.com/blackberry-sweet-rolls/
Published: 2019-08-31

Late summer, and you can find wild blackberries anywhere: the side of the highway, the park, beside the baseball field. As kids we ate them until our faces and hands were stained. This time I baked with them: sticky buns with cinnamon, bread and tangy fresh blackberries.


### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup buttermilk
- 2 teaspoons active dry yeast
- 1/4 cup plus 1 teaspoon granulated sugar
- 4 tablespoons butter (melted and slightly cooled)
- 2 eggs (room temp )
- 3 cups bread flour (AP flour will work too)
- 1 1/2 teaspoons salt
- 1 package fresh blackberries (about 1 1/3 cup)
- 4 tablespoons granulated sugar
- 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon
- 1/2 lemon (zested)
- 1 teaspoon lemon (juice)
- 1 tablespoon butter (softened)
- 1/4 cup cream Cheese (plain)
- 3/4 cup powdered sugar
- 1-2 tablespoons milk

### Method
1. Heat up buttermilk until warm. Add 1 teaspoon of sugar and the yeast. Allow to sit for 10 minutes (until foamy).
2. Add melted butter, rest of the sugar and eggs. Mix until well combined.
3. In a mixing bowl (I use the KitchenAid mixer) incorporate flour and salt. Make a well and add wet ingredients. With a dough hook, mix dough until it forms a ball. Knead for an additional 5-8 minutes.
4. Remove from bowl, form into a ball, spray bowl with nonstick and place back into the bowl covered with a dish towel. Allow to sit for 1 hour or until dough has more than doubled in size.
5. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add blackberries, lemon juice, lemon zest, sugar and cinnamon. Mash up blackberries and place in fridge until ready to use. Make sure mixture isn’t too wet as it will run through the rolls ( did that the first time ).
6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees F.
7. Grease a 9 – 9.5 inch pie plate. Set aside.
8. Once rested, roll out dough on a floured surface into a large rectangle. With room temp butter, spread butter onto the surface of the dough. Evenly spread out blackberry mixture leaving an inch around of room.
9. Using your hands, roll rectangle into a log. Cut log into 10-12 rolls placing each roll into the pie plate allowing the rolls to touch on the sides.
10. Allow rolls to rest another 10-15 minutes than bake in the oven for 20 minutes or until lightly golden on the top. Reduce heat to 300 and cook an additional 10 -15 minutes until a deep golden brown.
11. While the sticky rolls are baking, mix cream cheese, powdered sugar, and milk until a frosting forms. The frosting should be thin enough to drizzle. If too thick, add a teaspoon at a time of milk. If too thin, add a tablespoon of cream cheese at a time and mix.
12. Remove rolls from heat. Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes then drizzle cream cheese frosting over top and garnish with a couple berries.
13. Serve warm.

---

## Théasty New York-Style Bagels
URL: https://theasty.com/new-york-style-bagels/
Published: 2019-08-25

The Texan and I had our first date in New York City, and we got engaged there too. These bagels remind me of it. New York style is my preference (sorry, Montreal): chewier, bigger, bolder toppings. Making them is no harder than a loaf of bread, you just add boiling. Weigh the dough to divide evenly. Cheaper than store-bought, too.


### Ingredients
- 3 1/2 cups bread flour
- 2 teaspoons yeast
- 2 teaspoons salt
- 1 1/2 tablespoons sugar
- 1 1/4 cup luke warm water
- 1 whole egg (whisked)
- 1/2 cup onion (finely diced)
- 3 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1/4 cup black sesame seeds
- 1/2 cup smoked cheddar cheese (shredded)
- 1/4 cup poppy seeds

### Method
1. In a small bowl mix warm water, yeast and sugar. Let sit for 5 minutes.
2. In a large bowl, mix flour and salt. Make a well and add yeast mixture. Mix until you have a sticky dough. If the dough is still too dry, add a tablespoon of water at a time until it makes a firm dough.
3. Cover dough and bowl with oil and allow to rest for 1 – 1 1/2 hours with a towel over the bowl.
4. Once rested, punch dough and allow to rest another 10-15 minutes
5. On a baking sheet lined with parchment paper, divide into 8 equal pieces and allow to rest for another 15 minutes.
6. Roll each piece into a rope and loop around to form a circle with a large enough hole in it approx 1 1/2 – 2 inches (it’s better to have a bigger hole as it will rest again and then boil which makes the hole smaller) Allow to rest another 5-10 minutes.
7. Meanwhile, preheat oven to 425 degrees F and begin to boil a pot of water.
8. Once boiling, place 1-3 bagels into boiling water. cook for 1 1/2 minutes each side. * the longer you cook the chewier the bagel.
9. Place on a sheet pan with parchment paper and top with egg wash. Add desired toppings.
10. Place in the oven and bake for 20 minutes or until golden brown.
11. Remove from oven and allow to cool. Serve warm or store for up to a few days.

### Notes
Bagel dough should rest much longer to give a better texture. If you want to try resting that long, keep dough in fridge for 1 to 2 days.
Enjoy xo

---

## Street Corn Chicken Enchiladas
URL: https://theasty.com/street-corn-chicken-enchiladas/
Published: 2019-08-21

My weekends fill up fast, so I've started inviting my favourite people over on weekdays. Nobody wants to slave in the kitchen after work, which is why I love these: spiced chicken, green enchilada sauce, roasted corn, chilis, cheese and crema, baked in corn tortillas.

I made my own sauce from tomatillo salsa, but store-bought works. So does a rotisserie chicken.


### Ingredients
- 2 Boneless, skinless chicken breast
- 1 can chili in adobe sauce
- 4 cloves garlic (minced)
- 3 tablespoons lime juice
- 1 can green chilis (diced)
- 1/2 can corn
- 1/2 can black beans
- 2 cups shredded mozzarella cheese (1 cup for filling and 1 cup for on top.)
- 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
- 1/4 cup Chopped Green Onion (divided in half)
- 1/2 cup sweet onion (finely diced )
- 2 - 2 1/2 cups green enchilada sauce (depending on size of baking pan)
- 1/2 cup sour cream
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 2 tablespoons lime juice
- 2 teaspoons lime zest
- 1/4 cup goat Feta (to garnish)
- tajin (to garnish)
- 1 small Jalapeno Pepper (thinly sliced)
- chopped cilantro (to garnish)
- 8-10 Corn tortillas (small)

### Method
1. For the chicken filling: Preheat oven to 400 F
2. For the chicken filling: In an oven proof baking pan lined with parchment paper place chicken breast, minced garlic, chili in adobo sauce, and lime juice into the pan and mix until sauce coats the chicken. Place in oven and cook for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through.
3. For the chicken filling: Once cooked, remove from pan and shred with a fork. Place in bowl and allow to completely cool.
4. For the chicken filling: Once cool, add canned corn, black beans, mozzarella cheese, green onion, cilantro, sweet onion, and a can of chilies and 1/3 of your enchilada sauce. Mix well. * leave a little bit of the corn for the top of the enchiladas once they are finished cooking.
5. For the chicken filling: In a casserole dish, pour another 1/3 of your enchilada sauce on the bottom of the dish. Taking a corn tortilla, fill the center of the tortilla with the chicken filling and roll both sides in. Place seam side down in casserole dish. Continue until dish is full.
6. For the chicken filling: Pour remaining enchilada sauce over top and finish with remaining mozzarella cheese. Place in the oven for approximately 20 minutes or until cheese is golden brown. Remove from heat.
7. For the Street Corn Sauce: In a small bowl, mix lime juice, lime zest, garlic, sour cream until well combined.
8. To Finish: Drizzle street corn crema over top of enchiladas and top with , green onion, jalapeno slices, goat feta, cilantro, and Tajin.

### Notes
Overcooking the enchiladas or adding too much enchilada sauce can cause the corn tortillas to become too soft and will turn into mush. Less is more!
Flour tortillas can be substituted if you prefer

---

## Peach and Burrata Pasta with Crispy Prosciutto
URL: https://theasty.com/peaches-n-cream/
Published: 2019-08-05

Pasta is my blank canvas, and peaches are the last of summer. Burrata instead of a cream sauce, plus sweet corn and crispy prosciutto.


### Ingredients
- 2 large peaches (pitted. One cut into small wedges and one diced)
- 150 Grams prosciutto
- 2 corn on cob (shucked)
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1/4 cup dry white wine
- 2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- 1 cup Parmesean (grated)
- 3 tablespoons fresh basil (for garnish)
- 1 burrata ball (for topping)
- 400 grams papardelle (or other pasta )
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)

### Method
1. To make fresh pasta click here . You can opt for any other form of pasta (tagliatelle, papardelle, spaghetti etc. Whatever your heart desires)
2. On a grill pan or grill on medium heat, add corn and slowly roast, turning frequently, until it starts to turn brown. Once cooked, remove from heat, slice kernels off core and set aside. Meanwhile, add peach wedges on the grill and cook each side until tender but not super soft (about 2 minutes per side). Avoid moving the wedges to give a nice grill mark . Remove from heat and set aside.
3. With a medium sized skillet on medium high heat, add prosciutto and cook until crispy (5-6 minutes). Remove and place on paper towel until cool. Once cool, crunch into small pieces. Set aside.
4. In the same pan on on medium high heat, add 2 tablespoons of butter, garlic, diced peaches, and a pinch of salt. Saute until peaches are cooked through (about 5-8 minutes). Add white wine and cook an additional 5-7 minutes. Season with salt and pepper and remove from heat.
5. Boil water in a large pot heavily seasoned with salt and add pasta. If pasta is fresh, cook under a minute. If pre-made, cook to el dente (a couple minutes less than suggested cook time on packaging. Remove pasta from water and transfer to white wine peach sauce. Set heat back to medium- low. Add two tablespoons of olive oil, 3/4 of the corn and half a cup of grated Parmesan. Toss pasta in sauce until evenly incorporated and cheese is melted. If pasta is still too dry, add another tablespoon of butter or olive oil.
6. Divide pasta in desired serving dish (also good plated family style). Top with fresh burrata, grilled peaches, remaining corn, crispy prosciutto and fresh basil. Top it off with freshly cracked pepper and remaining Parmesan. Enjoy!

## Pillow Soft Pretzels
URL: https://theasty.com/pillow-soft-pretzels/
Published: 2019-07-18

Soft pretzels were my favourite as a child in Europe, served hot with a stick of European butter that melted right in. Back in Canada the pretzel game was sparse, so I tried many recipes. This is by far my favourite. Best eaten within a day, which is not hard here.


### Ingredients
- 1 1/2 cups warm water
- 1 package yeast
- 1 tablespoon brown sugar
- 3-4 cups flour
- 1 tablespoon unsalted butter (melted)
- 1/2 cup baking soda
- 10 cups water
- coarse salt

### Method
1. In a medium bowl pour in warm water and yeast and allow to sit for 5-10 minutes.
2. Add brown sugar, melted butter and mix. Gradually add flour until a dough forms. Knead for 10 minutes; place in a bowl and cover with a towel and let rise for 1 hour.
3. Preheat oven to 400 degrees F.
4. Meanwhile, fill a pot with approx. 10 cups of water and baking soda. Bring to a boil.
5. Divide the dough equally into 12 pieces for small pretzels or 6-8 for larger. Take each piece and roll into a rope about 12 inches long. Lift each end up, twist around and cross over and connecting the ends to the bottom part of the rope. Place onto parchment paper and repeat until each piece is done.
6. When the water is boiling, place each pretzel into the water and allow to cook for about 30-40 seconds. Remove from water with a slotted spoon and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. Sprinkle generously with coarse salt and continue until all pretzels have been boiled and salted.
7. Place in oven and cook for approx 20 minutes or until golden brown. Remove from heat and serve warm with butter.

### Notes
You can make any shape you like so if you want pretzel buns or other shape – do it!

---

## Simple Bruschetta
URL: https://theasty.com/bruschetta/
Published: 2019-07-06




### Ingredients
- 5 medium Tomatoes (diced)
- 4 cloves garlic (2 finely grated and 2 whole)
- 1 large bunch fresh basil
- 1 loaf french baguette (sliced)
- 2 tablespoons olive oil (plus some to drizzle)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 400 degree Fahrenheit. On a large baking sheet line the sliced baguette in rows and drizzle with olive oil. Place in oven and allow to crisp up (approx. 5-8 minutes).
2. Remove from oven and rub each slice with a garlic clove (should take two cloves for the whole loaf).
3. In a medium mixing bowl, add 2 tablespoons of olive oil, diced tomatoes, minced basil and mix. Add salt and pepper to taste and set in fridge until ready to serve.
4. To Serve: Spoon mixture onto toasted baguette and serve. For some extra goodness, grate some parmesan over top. YUM!

## Chicken, Watermelon and Burrata Sandwich
URL: https://theasty.com/chicken-watermelon-and-burrata-sandwich/
Published: 2019-06-29

After making watermelon salsa for tacos, I had half a watermelon in dire need of use. Hence this open-faced sandwich: watermelon, creamy burrata and grilled chicken. Hardly any prep, so it works for lunch or a light dinner on days you don't want to cook.


### Ingredients
- 2 Boneless, skinless chicken breast (seasoned heavily with salt and pepper)
- 2 ciabatta buns (cut in half)
- 2 cups Arugula
- 1/2 shallot (thinly sliced)
- 2 tablespoons olive oil (divided)
- 2 tablespoons pesto
- 100 grams Burrata cheese
- 1/2 cup cherry tomatoes (cut in half. colorful ones are the best! )
- 2 cups cubed watermelon
- drizzle (balsamic reduction)
- freshly cracked salt and pepper

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees F
2. Take seasoned chicken breast and place in a baking pan lined with parchment paper. Drizzle olive oil over top and bake in oven for 15-25 minutes flipping half way.
3. Remove from oven and allow to rest.
4. Meanwhile, in a small bowl, add olive oil, shallots and arugula. Toss until well incorporated. Set aside.
5. Place ciabatta in oven and lightly toast (about 4-5 minutes).
6. To Serve: Thinly slice chicken breast. Spread a small layer of pesto on toasted ciabatta. Add a good chunk of Burrata (i’ll let you be the judge as you should never tell a person how much Burrata to eat). Add sliced chicken, tomato, watermelon cubes and top with arugula salad and a drizzle of balsamic with freshly cracked salt and pepper.

### Notes
Cook time of chicken breast depends on size. For 7 oz chicken breast, cook time is between 15-20 minutes; for 10 oz chicken breast, it can take between 20-25 minutes.

---

## Simple Crepes
URL: https://theasty.com/simple-crepes/
Published: 2019-06-29

Crepes were the first recipe my mother taught me, and we ate them almost every week. Thin, rich, and good for breakfast, lunch or dinner. I've never measured this recipe: it's all about texture. No milk, use water. No butter, use oil. Sweet with vanilla or sugar, or plain. Just don't go stingy on the fat.


### Ingredients
- 1 cups all purpose flour
- 1 1/2 cup milk
- 3 tablespoons unsalted butter (melted and slightly cooled)
- 4 large eggs (lightly beaten)
- 1 teaspoon salt

### Method
1. Take out a medium sized non stick pan and melt 1/2 stick of butter on medium heat. Pour melted butter into a small bowl and allow to slightly cool. Allow the butter to coat the pan while you pour the butter into the bowl (this will coat the pan for the crepe cooking!).
2. In a large bowl, add flour and salt. Make a well and mix eggs, milk, and water until a there are no lumps. Make sure you slowly add the milk/water to ensure proper consistency. The consistency should be similar to pouring heavy cream (maybe a tad bit thicker).
3. Now comes trial and error.
4. Pour a small ladle of batter (anywhere from 1/2 to 3/4 full) into the frying pan at medium heat. With your wrist, swirl the batter until a light coat of batter covers the bottom of the pan evenly. The first crepe never turns out so don’t fret!
5. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes and turn over. Cook the other side for an additional 1 minute and slide on a plate. Repeat until batter is gone.
6. Topping Ideas: We like to have an array of different types of toppings to make it extra fun. Here are some of my favorites:
7. Topping Ideas: Nutella
8. Topping Ideas: Butter with brown sugar
9. Topping Ideas: Maple Syrup (a classic)
10. Topping Ideas: Plain yoghurt and Brown Sugar
11. Topping Ideas: Lemon Juice and Sugar (my favorite leftover crepe. Spread some lemon juice, roll, and dip in sugar)
12. Topping Ideas: Fruit yogurt and mix berries
13. Topping Ideas: Peanut butter and banana
14. Topping Ideas: Whipped cream and strawberries
15. Topping Ideas: Back bacon, fried egg and hollandaise
16. Problem: Batter is sticking
17. Solution: Ensure your heat is at proper temperature (medium heat).
18. Solution: Add an extra tablespoon of vegetable oil.
19. Solution: Ensure your using a non-stick pan and that it was properly coated
20. Problem: My crepe is too thick
21. Solution: Your batter may be too thick. add a tablespoon of water/milk until you reach proper consistency
22. Solution: If your consistency looks good, you may be pouring too much batter in. Try pouring in less

---

## Simple Watermelon Salsa
URL: https://theasty.com/watermelon-salsa/
Published: 2019-06-19

Pico with a juicy twist. I first made this for my steak and watermelon tacos, and since then it has gone on BBQ chicken, breakfast, and plain tortilla chips.

There are no rules: add tomato, swap in red onion, a jalapeno or serrano for heat, or a sprinkle of Tajin. Make it ahead and chill until serving.


### Ingredients
- 1/2 mini seedless watermelon (or about 1 1/2 - 2 cups of finely diced watermelon.)
- 1/4 cup chopped cilantro
- 1/4 large white onion (you can also use red onion)
- 1/2 bunch Green Onion (chopped)
- 1 tablespoon lime (juice)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)

### Method
1. Place diced watermelon, white onion, green onion and lime juice in a bowl. Season with salt and pepper and mix well. Store in fridge in a sealed container until ready to use.
2. The lime juice acts as a preserver so you should get a few days use out of the salsa if you don’t eat it all right away

## Spicy Goat Cheese + Sausage Rigatoni with Green Vegetables
URL: https://theasty.com/sausage-rigatoni/
Published: 2019-06-11

The pasta press attachment for my KitchenAid finally arrived, and first up was sausage rigatoni. Peas, Brussels sprouts and asparagus for the turn from spring to summer, chili flake and spicy sausage for pop, goat cheese to bring it together, and just a little olive oil so the pasta stays the star.


### Ingredients
- 2 links spicy italian sausage (removed from casing )
- 1/2 sweet onion (diced )
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 2 teaspoons Paprika
- 1 teaspoon chili flakes
- 1 cup medium sized asparagus (cut into 1 inch pieces)
- 3/4 cup small brussel sprouts (cut in half )
- 1/4 cup Peas
- 2 1/2 cups rigatoni (I used freshly made Mezzi Rigatoni )
- 2 tablespoon goat cheese (plus some for garnish)
- grated Parmesean (as much as you'd like )
- drizzle olive oil
- 1/2 lemon (juiced )
- 1/2 - 1 tablespoon lemon (zest)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)

### Method
1. Place a large pot of water on high heat seasoned heavily with salt.
2. Meanwhile, in a large pan on medium heat, add the spicy Italian sausage making sure to break the meat apart while cooking. Cook for about 5-7 minutes or until the meat appears to be fully cooked; Remove meat and place in a bowl lined with paper towel reserving the fat in the pan.
3. Add the brussel sprouts, sweet onion, asparagus and chili flakes, garlic and paprika with a pinch of salt – using the fat from the sausage to cook the vegetables. Cook vegetables until they are soft but are still bright with a bit of crunch. Mine took about 5-7 minutes but it all depends on the size and cook of your stovetop. Add two tablespoon of goat cheese and the lemon zest/juice. Mix until evenly incorporated.
4. Once water is boiling, add your pasta to the water and cook to el dente. For fresh pasta, this can take less than a minute. For store bought pasta, it will be closer to 8 minutes.
5. Strain pasta, reserving some pasta water, and transfer to the vegetable mixture. Add peas, cooked sausage and mix until well incorporated. If the pasta sauce is too thick, add a couple tablespoons of pasta water.
6. Dish into your favorite serving bowl, drizzle some olive oil and top with Parmesan, chili flakes, salt and pepper. Enjoy!

---

## Blood Orange Peach + Berry Dutch Babies
URL: https://theasty.com/blood-orange-peach-berry-dutch-babies/
Published: 2019-06-10

My eyes are bigger than my stomach at the summer produce stand. After blood orange jalapeno margaritas, I had too many blood oranges left, so with a lazy weekend ahead I made Dutch babies for brunch with whatever fruit was in the fridge.

The batter is flour, eggs and milk, sweet or savoury. I'm not big on sweet mornings, so I went with honey whipped ricotta. You could eat it with a spoon.


### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup all purpose flour
- 2/3 cup milk
- 1 1/2 tablespoons powdered sugar
- 1/2 large blood orange (zested)
- 1 large Peach (cut into slices)
- 5-6 large Strawberries (cut into slices)
- 8 blackberries
- 1 tablespoon Sugar (less if you don't want them too sweet)
- 2-3 tablespoons Blood Orange juice
- 2 Large eggs
- pinch of salt (to help bring out the flavor of the berries)
- 3/4 cup ricotta cheese
- 1/2 cup cream Cheese
- 2 tablespoons honey
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extrct
- 1/4 large blood orange (zested)
- 2 tablespoons butter
- 1 tablespoon powdered sugar (dusted)

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 450 Degrees F
2. For the Berries: Place cut berries and peaches in a bowl with the sugar, blood orange juice and pinch of salt. Mix until evenly coated and allow to sit in the fridge until ready to serve.
3. For The Whipped Ricotta: In a food processor add cream cheese, ricotta, blood orange zest, and vanilla. Blend until smooth. Alternatively, you can hand mix.
4. For The Whipped Ricotta: Place in serving bowl, cover and place in fridge until ready to serve
5. For the Dutch Baby: In a food processor or blender, blend eggs, flour, milk and blood orange zest until incorporated and makes a wet batter.
6. For the Dutch Baby: In a large cast iron or oven proof pan/skillet place 2 tablespoons of butter. Place pan in oven and allow the butter to just melt. Quickly pull pan out and spread butter to coat the entire pan. Pour batter into pan and place back into the oven. Cook for approximately 20 minutes until brown.
7. For the Dutch Baby: If the pancake is getting too dark, reduce heat to 425 degrees F.
8. For the Dutch Baby: Remove from oven and serve right away. Top with fruit and whipped ricotta and finish with a dusting of powdered sugar.

## Blood Orange Jalapeno Margarita
URL: https://theasty.com/blood-orange-jalapeno-margarita/
Published: 2019-05-23

I like my margarita spicy and on the rocks. Fresh blood orange replaces the orange liqueur, adding sweet citrus and a subtle hint of raspberry. For the best spice, infuse the jalapeno in the tequila overnight, or for 15 minutes to an hour in a jug, or shake it with ice. Making it for a group? Prep the tequila ahead.


### Ingredients
- 1 cup tequila (the better quality the better the taste)
- 3/4 cup freshly squeeze blood orange juice
- 1/2 cup lime juice
- 1 tablespoon liquid sweetener (optional )
- Ice (for the glass)
- Tajin and a lime wedge to rim the glass (to rim the glass. If you don't have Tajin then use a coarse salt)
- fresh slices blood orange (for garnish)
- 1 Jalapeno Pepper (cut into half )

### Method
1. Place tequila in a cup or jug with half the jalapeno. Allow the jalapeno time to infuse tequila. The longer the jalapeno sits, the spicier the tequila.
2. Mix blood orange juice, lime juice, and optional sweetener with tequila. Give a good stir.
3. Rub rim of glass with lime wedge and dip in Tajin.
4. Add ice to desired glass and pour in Margarita mix.
5. Serve with a blood orange slice and thinly slice jalapenos.

---

## Brioche Buns
URL: https://theasty.com/brioche-buns/
Published: 2019-05-10

Fluffy, golden buns, just in time for burger season. I started from the New York Times recipe and changed one thing: no water in the oven. They seemed completely fine without it.

Homemade buns usually go stale almost immediately. These stayed fluffy, which makes me love the recipe even more.


### Ingredients
- 1 cup warm water
- 3 tablespoons warm milk
- 2 teaspoons active dry yeast (equivelent to one packet )
- 1 1/2 tablespoons Sugar
- 2 large eggs
- 3 cups bread flour
- 1/3 cup all purpose flour
- 1 1/2 teaspoon salt
- 2 1/2 tablespoons unsalted butter
- sesame seeds (as a topping but not required )

### Method
1. In a small to medium sized bowl combine one cup warm water, warm milk, yeast and sugar. Let stand until foamy (between 5-10 minutes). In the mean time, beat one egg in a small glass and set aside.
2. In a large bowl, combine bread flour, all purpose flour and salt. Add the butter to the dry ingredients and rub into the flour using your fingers or a making crumbs. Stir in the yeast mixture with the beaten egg and mix until it forms a ball. Place tacky dough on a floured surface and kneed until smooth and elastic (approximately 10 minutes). Shape dough into a ball and return it to bowl. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let rise until doubled in size (about 1 – 2 hours).

### Notes
Dough should remain slightly tacky, as the more flour you add, the tougher they will be when baked.
Take a large baking sheet and line with parchment paper. Divide dough into 8 pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and place on baking sheet.
Give enough room as the balls will rise and take up quite a bit of space. If needed, use two baking sheets to make sure there is sufficient room. Cover balls with plastic wrap lightly coated in nonstick spray and allow the dough balls to rise again for about 1-2 hours.
Gauge when they are ready by the size they increase after the second rise. The rise should be the size of bun you wish to have.
Preheat oven to 400 degrees F with a rack in the middle of the oven.
Take the last egg, beat in a cup with 1 tablespoon water and brush on top of buns. At this point, you can sprinkle with sesame seeds.
Bake, buns until tops are golden brown (about 15 minutes). Allow to cool unless you want to eat one beforehand with melted butter YUM!
These buns can be frozen, for up to 2 to 3 months BONUS!
Enjoy! xo

---

## Steak & Watermelon Tacos
URL: https://theasty.com/steak-watermelon-tacos/
Published: 2019-05-04

*you can use any type of steak for the recipe, I 

prefer tenderloin or marinated flank steak (seen above).


### Ingredients
- 1-2 Pounds Flank Steak
- 2 Tablespoons olive oil
- 2 tsp Chili powder
- 2 Tablespoons lime juice
- Salt and Pepper
- 3/4 Cup chopped cilantro
- 1/2 Mini Watermelon (Or about 1 1/2 - 2 cups of finely diced watermelon)
- 1/4 Bunch Cilantro
- 1/4 white onion (Can also opt for red)
- 1/2 Bunch Green Onion
- 1 Lime
- Salt and Pepper (To taste)
- 1 Habanero
- 1/2 Pineapple
- Salt and Pepper (To taste)
- 1/4 Head Red Cabbage
- 1 Cup Vinegar
- 1 Cup Sugar
- 1 Clove garlic (Smashed)
- 8 Corn tortillas
- 2 whole Avocados (Peeled, pitted and cut into large chunks.)
- 4 ounces Soft Goat Cheese
- 1/2 head Chopped Lettuce (Your preference)
- 1 ounce sour cream (1 dollop per taco)

### Method
1. For the Steak: Add garlic, chili powder, olive oil, lime juice and cilantro in a seal-able container big enough to fit your flank steak. Season flank steak generous with salt and pepper. Set into container, close with lid and shake ingredients until steak is fullly coated. Place in fridge to marinate for minimum an hour or overnight. The acid from the lime juice helps tenderize the meat.
2. For the quick picked cabbage: In a small pot on med-high heat put vinegar and sugar together and heat until just boiling and sugar is dissolved. Add Cabbage, garlic and vinegar mixture in a container and put in fridge. Allow to sit for a minimum of 30 mins * add enough cabbage that it is fully covered by the vinegar mixture
3. For the roasted habanero & pineapple salsa: Preheat oven to 425 degrees. Roast the habanero until it starts to char. Let cool. Once cool enough, Remove seeds by cutting the habenaro in half and cleaning out under cold water (wear gloves).
4. For the roasted habanero & pineapple salsa: Cut Pineapple into small cubes and add to blender with the juice of 3 limes and habanero. Puree until smooth and season with salt and pepper. Put into squeeze bottle and set aside in fridge
5. For the watermelon Salsa: Place finely diced watermelon, onion, green onion, and cilantro into bowl. Squeeze the juice of 1 lime and season with salt and pepper. Set aside in fridge
6. For the watermelon Salsa: Preheat oven to 400 degrees
7. For the watermelon Salsa: Heat cast iron skillet on medium high heat. Add steaks to skillet and cook for 4 minutes on each side or until preferred doneness. Take off the grill, wrap in tinfoil and let rest for 10 minutes.
8. For the watermelon Salsa: Alternatively, you can grill on BBQ or put steak on a baking sheet and cook at 450 degrees for 12 – 15 minutes.
9. For the watermelon Salsa: Wrap tortillas in tinfoil and put in oven until heated. Alternatively, you can place tortillas in a hot cast iron grill to give a slight char.
10. For the watermelon Salsa: Cut steak into thin slices (against the grain).
11. To Serve: Take a tortilla, add a dollop of sour cream, steak, avocado, lettuce, watermelon pico, pickled cabbage and radish. Top with goat cheese and pineapple habanero salsa.
12. To Serve: Mmmm Mmm Good!
13. To Serve: Bring napkins!

---

## Italian Eggs in Purgatory
URL: https://theasty.com/italian-eggs-in-purgatory/
Published: 2019-04-18

You know I love a good brunch item. Something that is hearty but takes less than 20 minutes to make. Sign. me. up.

And you also may know that I paid a visit recently to
 Famoso Neapolitan pizzeria
 to show 
5 things you didn’t know about Neapolitan pizza.

What intrigued me most about this pizzeria is that everything from their dough to their sauces are made the traditional way.  They even import their tomatoes from Campania, then hand-mill these tomatoes before they caramelize them to perfection… 
no wonder I love their sauce

. 

So what does that have to do with brunch?

Well, when Famoso launched their brand new authentico Pomodoro sauce and partnered with MealShare to do some good in the community, I happily jumped on board to make a delicious recipe using their new sauce. And that, my friends, is where brunch comes in.

One of my favorite tomato dishes to make is “Uova al Purgatorio” or Eggs in Purgatory which is essentially eggs cooked into a spicy tomato sauce.   This dish has many variations but one that I love has Italian Sausage, fresh garlic and chili flakes served with lightly toasted sourdough rubbed with garlic.

And since we have an authentic sauce already done, we skip the time to make it ourselves #winning.

Check out the recipe below to make your own Eggs in Purgatory.

 until April 22nd, 2019
, all proceeds of every $8 jar is donated to 
MealShare
 to provide meals for youth in need in your community.


### Ingredients
- 1 500ml tomato Sauce (using Famoso's Pomodoro Sauce)
- 3 whole eggs
- 1/2 small sweet onion (diced)
- 1 tablespoon chili flakes (can use less if you dont like it so spicy)
- 3 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1/2 tablespoon garlic powder
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 2 links italian sausage (removed from casing)
- 1/4 cup parsley (finely chopped)
- 1/4 cup crumbled goat cheese (for garnish)
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)

### Method
1. In a skillet on medium to medium high heat, add olive oil and sweet onion. Saute onion for about a minute.
2. Add Italian sausage, minced garlic, chili flakes, paprika, and garlic powder. Cook until sausage is fully cooked (about 5-7 minutes).
3. Pour in tomato sauce giving a good stir and allowing to cook another 3-5 minutes. Crack an egg one-at-a-time into the tomato sauce. Cook eggs with lid on until eggs are white and no longer translucent.
4. Remove from heat.
5. Garnish with fresh parsley and crumbled goat cheese. Serve by itself or with some freshly toasted bread of your choice.

## Creamy Chicken Marsala
URL: https://theasty.com/creamy-chicken-marsala/
Published: 2019-04-05

Some dishes smell like they cooked for hours. This one takes one pan and half an hour. A play on a classic Italian dish, with wine and simple ingredients. There's a video of me making it too.


### Ingredients
- 2 chicken breast (Boneless Skinless and filet in half)
- 1 1/2 cups AP Flour (you can also sub for almond flour )
- 2 tablespoons olive oil
- 3 tablespoons butter
- 1/2 large sweet onion (diced)
- 2 cups button mushrooms (sliced)
- 4-5 cloves garlic (minced)
- 3/4 cups Marsala Wine
- 1/2 cup chicken stock (or broth)
- 3 sprigs fresh thyme
- 1/2 cup Cream
- 1/4 cup Fresh Parsley (finely chopped)

### Method
1. Lightly coat chicken cutlets in flour and set aside.
2. In a medium to large skillet on medium high heat, add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and 1 tablespoon of butter. Add chicken cutlets to pan and cook on each side until golden brown (about 1-2 minutes per side).
3. Remove from heat and set aside.
4. With the same skillet, add 1-2 tablespoons of butter, diced onion and mushrooms. Add a pinch of salt and pepper then cook until onions are translucent in color (about 2-3 minutes). Add minced garlic and cook an additional 1-2 minutes.
5. Pour Marsala wine and chicken stock into the skillet. Add thyme. Bring to a boil and reduce liquid until it thickens (about 10 – 15 minutes).
6. Once the sauce can coat the back of a spoon, add cream and cook until thick again.
7. Replace cooked chicken cutlets back into sauce and cook for an additional 2 minutes. Garnish with parsley and serve with rice, potatoes, pasta or on its own.

---

## Sweet Chili Corn Soup
URL: https://theasty.com/sweet-chili-corn-soup/
Published: 2019-03-09

Corn is one of my all-time favourite ingredients. In summer I eat it weekly, usually on the cob with butter. Can't choose between sweet corn and spice? Have both: the corn's sweetness, a hint of honey and a kick of chili. You basically throw it in a pot and blend. Basically.


### Ingredients
- 1 corn on the cob (shucked )
- 1 medium shallot (diced)
- 1/2 carrot (diced)
- 1 medium orange bell pepper (diced)
- 2 cloves garlic (minced)
- 4 cups frozen corn ((frozen seems to have more flavor))
- 1 medium sweet onion (diced)
- 1 teaspoon Paprika
- 1/2 teaspoon corrander
- pinch cayenne
- 1 teaspoon salt (or to taste)
- 2 litres chicken stock (or if making vegetarian, use vegetable stock)
- 1/4 cup honey
- 2 tablespoon lime juice
- 2 tablespoons chili oil (to garnish)
- chili flakes (to garnish)
- 4 tablespoons sour cream (to garnish)
- 1 whole lime (sliced into wedges)

### Method
1. In a medium pot add corn on the cob in enough water to cover the corn entirely. Place on high heat until water starts to boil. Cook corn for about 7-8 minutes or until kernels are tender. Remove from water and allow to cool.
2. In a large pot on medium-high heat add grapeseed oil, onion, shallot, carrots, orange bell pepper, frozen corn, garlic, paprika, cayenne, corriander and a pinch of salt. Reduce heat to medium and saute for 6-8 minutes. Add half the stock and cook until vegetables are soft. Transfer mixture to a blender and blend until smooth. Transfer blended mixture through a mesh sieve to get the soup extra smooth and place back into a pot on medium low heat.
3. Add honey, lime juice and additional stock to desired consistency. Season with additional salt to taste.
4. To Serve: Cut corn off the cob and set aside. Dish soup into desired bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream, fresh corn off the cob, a pinch of chili flakes and a drizzle of chili oil. Top with a lime wedge and enjoy! xo

### Notes
Use your own palette to determine if you want more seasoning or less. I prefer more but don’t be shy, you do you!
I add diced avocado for some extra texture
You can use whatever type of corn you would like, I find frozen has the most flavor (oddly enough)
The carrot and bell pepper give the soup a better color and it doesn’t hurt to sneak in some more veggies!
On hot days, eat this soup chilled. It tastes just as good!
To make vegan, omit the sour cream and ensure you use veggie stock!

---

## Beef Stroganoff
URL: https://theasty.com/beef-stroganoff/
Published: 2019-03-08

Every week for years, I ordered the beef Stroganoff at the French restaurant where my parents took us and the chefs let us brûlée our own desserts. The restaurant is gone. The Stroganoff isn't.


### Ingredients
- 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
- 2 Top Sirloin Steaks (about 450 g - cut into 1/4 inch cubes)
- 1/2 cup AP Flour (in a bowl- for coating steak)
- 1 shallot (diced)
- 4 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1/2 medium sweet onion (diced)
- 1 tablespoon garlic powder
- 1 package button mushrooms (cut into quarters or sliced thin)
- 1/2 bunch fresh thyme
- 1 cup dry red wine
- 1-2 cups beef broth
- 1/4 tablespoon Dijon Mustard
- 3/4 cup frozen peas
- 150 ml sour cream (about half a standard container)
- 1 small package farfalle pasta ((or make from scratch using my pasta recipe))
- Salt and Pepper (to taste)

### Method
1. Add cornstarch with water and mix until smooth. Set aside.
2. Toss beef cubes into flour until lightly coated. In a large nonstick skillet, heat vegetable oil over high heat. Add beef and cook until brown (6 minutes). Remove beef from pan and set aside.
3. In the same pan, add mushrooms, pinch of salt and pepper and garlic powder. Cook until mushrooms are browned. Add sweet onion, shallot, garlic and thyme. Cook for another 2-3 minutes.
4. Add beef and red wine to the pan and allow to reduce by half. Next, add 1 cup of broth and mustard, stirring until well combined. Add cornstarch mixture and cook until it’s slightly thickened (6-8 minutes). Remove from heat and add sour cream and frozen peas. Mix until well combined.
5. Meanwhile, in a medium pot boil water, heavily seasoned with salt. Cook noodles according to the package. If you opted to make your own pasta (yay!) then allow less than a minute to cook in boiling water.
6. Add cooked noodles into the pan with sauce and fold until coated. Serve in desired dish and garnish with a generous amount of Parmesan.

### Notes
To ensure extra tender meat, slow cook the meat in the sauce adding extra broth as it reduces (20+ minutes)
If sauce is too thick, add extra broth
Make sure to add the frozen peas at the last minute to keep their texture. If you add them too soon, they will become mushy.
If the sauce is cool from folding the sour cream in, put back on stove on medium heat, stirring until hot.

---

## Sheet Pan Steak Tacos
URL: https://theasty.com/sheet-pan-steak-tacos/
Published: 2019-02-24

Asked what one thing I'd eat for the rest of my life, I said tacos. Surprising, given my pasta obsession, but they're endlessly versatile: different proteins, different toppings, almost anything goes.

My tacos usually involve pickled red onion, slow braised meat and homemade cremas. This sheet pan version is just as good, and a lot quicker.


### Ingredients
- 1/2 cup olive oil
- 1/4 cup brown sugar
- 1/4 cup Cilantro (loosely chopped )
- 5 cloves garlic (minced)
- 1/2 tablespoon Ground pepper
- 2 tablespoons garlic powder
- 1 tablespoon Paprika
- 1/2 tablespoon Cumin
- 2 teaspoons cayenne pepper
- 1/4 cup lime juice
- 1 tablespoon Sriracha
- 2 teaspoons salt
- 2 lbs Flank Steak
- 1 whole Yellow Pepper (thick julienne)
- 1 whole red pepper (thick julienne)
- 1/2 Red Onion (Mirepoix)
- 1 tablespoon olive oil
- 1 tablespoon garlic powder
- 1/2 tablespoon Chili powder
- 1/2 tablespoon Paprika
- 2 cobs corn (shucked and cut in half and then lengthwise)
- 2 whole Mangos (peeled, pitted and diced)
- 1 whole tomato (diced)
- 1/4 red onion (diced)
- 1/4 cup green onion (chopped )
- 1 lime (juiced)
- salt and pepper (to taste)
- 12 small tortillas (flour or corn )
- 2 avocado (peeled, pitted and sliced thin)
- 2 cups field greens (or other preferred greens)
- 1/4 cup goat feta

### Method
1. For the Steak: Add all the marinade ingredients into a bowl and whisk until combined. Place steak into a seal-able container with marinade and place in fridge for minimum 4 hours.
2. For the Salsa: Combine mango, red onion, tomato, lime juice, salt and pepper in a bowl and mix until incorporated. Cover in saran wrap and place in fridge until ready to serve.
3. The Rest: Once steak has marinaded, preheat oven to 400 degrees.
4. The Rest: Place peppers and onion in a bowl and drizzle with olive oil. Sprinkle with garlic powder, chili powder, cumin and paprika then mix.
5. The Rest: On a large baking sheet, place peppers and onions on 1/3 of the baking sheet. Add sliced corn on another third of the baking sheet drizzled with olive oil. Remove steak from marinade and place on the final third of the baking sheet.
6. The Rest: Place in oven for approx 15-18 minutes with the last couple minutes on broil to give the steak a nice crust.
7. The Rest: Remove from heat and allow to cool for 5 minutes.
8. The Rest: Slice steak into strips and serve on a tortilla with mango salsa and avocado slices.

---

## Southwestern Salad in a Jar
URL: https://theasty.com/southwestern-salad-in-a-jar/
Published: 2019-02-19

I eat out a lot, and too many lunches end up being a $25 salad I could have made at home. So I made a Southwestern salad that takes little effort. The chicken goes in the oven while you put your feet up, and stacked properly in a jar with a bit of lime juice, the salad keeps for 4 to 6 days.

Keep the wet stuff at the bottom. Dressing can go in a small container on top.


### Ingredients
- 3 chicken breast (boneless, skinless)
- 3 Tablespoons olive oil
- 2 Tablespoon garlic powder
- 1 Tablespoon Chili powder
- 1/2 Tablespoon Cumin
- 1/2 Tablespoon Paprika
- 1 Teaspoon salt
- 1 Teaspoon pepper
- 1 Cup salsa
- 3/4 Cup Black beans
- 3/4 Cup corn kernels
- 3 - 4 Cups lettuce (spring mix or other)
- 2 Whole Avocado (peeled, pitted and diced)
- 1/4 Cup Red Onion (diced)
- 4 Tablespoons Goat Feta
- 2 Tablespoons lime juice

### Method
1. Preheat oven to 350 F. Line a small baking pan with tin foil.
2. In a small bowl, mix olive oil, garlic powder, chili powder, cumin, paprika, salt and pepper. Add Chicken and evenly coat.
3. Place chicken in pan and bake until cooked (approx. 25 – 30 minutes). Once cooked, remove from oven and allow to cool completely.
4. In medium sized mason jars, begin to stack your salad starting with the Salsa. The wet ingredients on the bottom will ensue that the rest of the salad doesn’t get soggy.
5. Add the beans, corn, chicken, lettuce, avocado and goat feta in that order (from bottom to top). Add lime juice on top covering the avocado pieces. This will keep the avocado from going brown right away.
6. When ready to eat, Shake the salad until combined (or mix in a small bowl) and devour!

---

## Energy Balls
URL: https://theasty.com/energy-balls/
Published: 2019-02-19

It is 3 o'clock, you want something sweet and salty, and a handful of nuts will not cut it. These take ten minutes and keep me away from the newsstand chocolate bars.


### Ingredients
- 1/2 Cup instant oats
- 1 Cup dates
- 3 Tablespoons mixed seeds
- 1/2 Cup peanut butter
- 4 Tablespoons honey
- 3 Tablespoons cocoa nibs
- 3 Tablespoons shredded coconut
- 2 Tablespoons dried cranberries
- 2 Tablespoons almonds
- 1/2 Tablespoon coarse salt

### Method
1. In a food processor, add all ingredients except salt. Pulse until mixture starts to combine. If the ingredients are not coming together, add more dates or peanut butter until the mixture starts to stick together. Remove combined mixture from processor and roll golf ball size balls. Sprinkle balls with sea salt and place in ziplock bags. Refrigerate and consume as desired.
